subject: E-5403: totals mismatch on Linux
body:
Hello support team. We run CourierOS 3.5.5 on Fedora 41.
Starting Tuesday, the moment I export the report a dialog
reads 'E-5403: totals do not match source'.

I switched the system regional format to one that uses comma
decimals. Thousands separators and decimals appear exchanged
in the totals.

Before writing in I attempted closing each other program; same
error afterwards.

Thanks, Fatima Zahra (Oakline Partners)
